releases.title: 本机流式听写：边说边出字
highlights: 即刻对话默认本机 Zipformer 中英流式识别：边说边出字、停顿补标点、松手即贴，不扣语音积分
云端 SenseVoice 仅作未就绪底线和可选二次校对
Windows 安装包 / 绿色版同步更新
highlightsEn: TalkNow defaults to on-device bilingual Zipformer streaming: live words, pause punctuation, paste on release, no voice credits
Cloud SenseVoice is fallback and optional proofread only
Windows installer and portable builds updated

releases.title: 看屏幕与设置体验更新
highlights: 看屏幕问答与首页/设置/帮助文案与交互改进
语音与会员相关能力继续打磨
Windows 安装包直链更新
highlightsEn: Screen-ask plus home/settings/help UX polish
Continued voice and membership refinements
Updated Windows installer download link

releases.title: 口述校对：去水词与改错别字
releases.titleEn: Dictation cleanup: fillers and STT typos
highlights: 即刻对话可自动去掉嗯啊呃等水词，并按上下文改正转写错字（设置里可关）
点按贴口述、按住增强都会先校对；不把具体错词写进场景包
官网顶栏显示当前版本；macOS 下载改为敬请期待，Windows 安装包照常提供
highlightsEn: TalkNow can strip spoken fillers and fix STT typos from context (toggles in Settings)
Tap-to-paste and hold-to-enhance both clean the transcript first; no scene-pack hardcoding
Site header shows the current version; macOS download is coming soon, Windows installer stays live

releases.title: 托盘、语音与站内下载加固
releases.titleEn: Tray, voice, and site download hardening
highlights: 托盘图标与菜单更稳；语音输入与修饰键触发体验改进
会员/账户相关能力与官网下载链路（Win 直链）修复
更新日志页链接与内容展示修复，避免 &lang= 导致 404
highlightsEn: More reliable tray icon/menu; improved voice input and modifier-key triggers
Membership/account updates and Windows site download link fixes
Changelog URL/lang query fix (no more &lang= 404) and SSR content

releases.title: 本地套件一键安装修复
highlights: 修：一点「一键安装本地套件」就报 sharp/libvips 错误
发版前校验原生语音依赖；语音半边失败时提示更清楚，对话模型仍可单独就绪
highlightsEn: Fix: one-click local suite failing immediately on sharp/libvips
Verify native ASR deps before release; clearer errors if voice install fails while chat models succeed

releases.title: 程序坞图标用着用着消失
highlights: 修：用一会儿或多次触发功能后主窗口被 HUD 藏掉、程序坞图标消失
附属窗弹出后按原状态恢复主窗口（显示 / 缩小），并确保 Dock 可见
highlightsEn: Fix: Dock icon vanishing after using features for a while (HUD hiding the main window)
Restore main window visibility/minimized state after aux windows; keep Dock shown

releases.title: 缩小后调用功能不丢程序坞
releases.titleEn: Keep Dock icon when triggering while minimized
highlights: 主窗口缩到程序坞后再用语音/帮我对话/看屏幕，不再把程序坞图标弄丢
HUD / 录音附属窗改为 panel，并在弹出后恢复主窗口最小化状态
highlightsEn: Triggering voice / reply / screen ask while minimized no longer drops the Dock icon
HUD and recorder use panel windows and restore the main window’s minimized state

releases.title: 程序坞缩小行为
highlights: 点关闭/缩小时窗口会留在程序坞，再点图标即可恢复
真退出请用 ⌘Q 或菜单栏图标右键「退出即刻对话」
highlightsEn: Close/minimize keeps the window in the Dock — click the icon to restore
To fully quit: ⌘Q or menu-bar tray → Quit

releases.title: 消除辅助功能反复弹窗
highlights: Mac 未签名包不再调用 uIOhook / System Events，从根上避免「辅助功能访问」反复弹窗
快捷键请用 Command+8（语音）、Command+0（帮我对话）、Command+1（看屏幕）或首页按钮
粘贴改为剪贴板兜底；辅助功能改为可选项
highlightsEn: Unsigned Mac builds no longer call uIOhook / System Events — stops Accessibility dialog loops
Use Command+8 (voice), Command+0 (reply), Command+1 (screen ask), or home buttons
Paste falls back to clipboard; Accessibility is optional

releases.title: Mac 权限体验
highlights: 辅助功能勾选后不再反复弹系统窗：改为提示 ⌘Q 完全退出再重开
语音前主动申请麦克风，设置页「打开」会先触发系统授权再跳转
权限文案更清楚：麦克风未授权时给出可操作提示
highlightsEn: Accessibility: stop repeated system prompts after grant — ask to ⌘Q quit and reopen
Request microphone before voice; Settings “Open” triggers the system prompt first
Clearer microphone-denied guidance

releases.title: 稳定与开发版标识
highlights: 按系统测试报告修复：Esc 取消保留草稿、答案 HUD 点击穿透、TTS 可 Esc 停播
首页指挥台顶部不再被裁切；开发版窗口/轨/Dock 带「开发」标识
宣传站语言链、Changelog 标题、英文默认文案与 releases 回退更稳
对话空线程文案、删除会话跳转、权限引导二次确认等体验修正
highlightsEn: QA fixes: keep draft on Esc cancel, answer HUD click-through, Esc stops TTS
Home hero no longer clips at the top; Dev builds show a clear Dev badge
Marketing site: language links, changelog title, English defaults, releases fallback
Empty-thread copy, delete-session navigation, permission-guide confirm polish

releases.title: 商用界面与宣传站
highlights: 桌面 UI 大改版：图标轨导航、首页指挥台、设置分组
宣传站上线（www.talknow.cn）
更新日志：网站与 App「更新」页共用同一份发版数据
下载入口直达 GitHub Releases
highlightsEn: Desktop UI refresh: icon rail, home command center, grouped settings
Marketing site at www.talknow.cn
Changelog shared by the website and the in-app Updates page
Download CTAs point to GitHub Releases

releases.title: Esc 立刻取消
highlights: 语音 / 帮我对话 / 看屏幕进行中按 Esc 立刻停下
停麦、停播报、中断转写与模型请求
highlightsEn: Press Esc during voice / reply / screen ask to stop immediately
Stops mic, speech, transcription, and model requests

releases.title: 墨色信号 VI
highlights: 全新视觉：浅底墨黑 + 电青强调
App 图标、托盘、HUD、权限引导统一去紫
highlightsEn: New look: light ink base with cyan accent only
App icon, tray, HUD, and permission guide drop purple

releases.title: HUD 过程反馈
highlights: 看屏幕长流程底部浮窗持续显示阶段与动效
与其它快捷键撞车时重亮进度提示
highlightsEn: Screen Ask shows ongoing phases in the bottom HUD
Busy conflicts re-highlight the progress tip

releases.title: 看屏幕快捷键调整
highlights: 看屏幕默认 Command+1 / Win+1
语音播报改用更自然的系统中文音色
highlightsEn: Screen Ask defaults to Command+1 / Win+1
Spoken replies use a more natural Chinese system voice

releases.title: 看屏幕对话归档
highlights: 侧栏对话列表保存截图与问答
可继续同一会话多轮提问
highlightsEn: Sidebar chats keep screenshots and Q&A
Continue multi-turn questions in the same session

releases.title: 看屏幕问答
highlights: 截整屏 + 语音提问，HUD 展示并复制回答
highlightsEn: Capture the full screen, ask by voice; HUD shows and copies the answer

releases.title: 能力更名与硬件键
highlights: 对外名：即刻对话 / 帮我对话
硬件隐藏键 Command/Win+8、+0
highlightsEn: Public names: TalkNow / Reply Assist
Hidden hardware keys Command/Win+8 and +0
